title: Launch raid tier is 10 + 20 + 40, all opening 9 December
classic: Phase 1 raiding was Molten Core and Onyxia, both 40-player.
forever: Barrow Deeps (10 players, 8 bosses), Hyjal Summit (20 players, 13 bosses) and Onyxia's Lair (40) all open on 9 December 2026; Molten Core is not part of the launch tier.
impact: A guild needs a 20-player core plus 10-player splits, not one 40-player roster, for most of its loot.

title: All raids reset weekly, Onyxia included
classic: Onyxia's Lair reset every 5 days; 40-player raids reset weekly.
forever: Blizzard's raid overview says all raids are currently planned to reset weekly; whether the 10 and 20 share a lockout is not published.
impact: Onyxia becomes a once-a-week raid, and splitting rules for 10s need checking in the client on day one.

title: New raids have no attunement; Onyxia keeps the Drakefire Amulet chain
classic: Onyxia required the long faction Drakefire Amulet questline.
forever: The Onyxia chain is nearly identical to Classic (amulet only has to be in bags); Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit list no attunement.
impact: Start Onyxia attunements now (UBRS/Drakkisath runs); the new raids need nothing but level 60.

title: Barrow Deeps: three entrances and branching paths
classic: Classic raids were linear and entered from one portal.
forever: Barrow Deeps (Illidan's old prison) has entrances via Mount Hyjal, Winterspring and Blackmaw Hold, with multiple paths; whether each entrance is a separate wing is unknown.
impact: Plan summons and meeting points per wing; boss order may be flexible.

title: Hyjal Summit is a new post-Archimonde raid with branching routes
classic: Hyjal Summit was a 25-player Burning Crusade raid (Archimonde).
forever: A 20-player, 13-boss raid set after Archimonde's death: an opening guardian fight, then multiple paths above and below ground converging on final bosses; Fel corruption themes.
impact: Your 20-player team's main progression raid; expect learning nights since there is no PTR.

title: No PTR for raids; bosses unseen until opening night
classic: Classic raids were long since datamined and documented.
forever: Blizzard says there will be no PTR for new raid content; Josh Greenfield says players will not know the bosses until they first enter.
impact: No boss guides or DBM/BigWigs timers will exist on night one; budget wipe time and record your own strats.

title: Raids restricted to your own ruleset and faction
classic: Realm-based raiding; cross-realm was not a factor.
forever: One mega-realm per ruleset per region; GuildOrder says raids are open only to players on the same ruleset and faction.
impact: Your raid pool is guild members on your ruleset; Hardcore or PvP alts on other rulesets cannot join.

title: Single difficulty; Tier 1 spread across all three raids
classic: Tier sets came from one raid each (T1 Molten Core, T2 BWL).
forever: Each raid has one difficulty and the Tier 1 set is split across Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia (ConquestCapped/Kami-Labs); class guides name only Hyjal and Barrow Deeps as tier sources.
impact: Full sets need both the 10 and the 20 every week.

title: Two raids per tier cadence through 2027
classic: Classic released one major raid per phase.
forever: Spring 2027 adds a 10-player and a 20-player raid; summer 2027 adds one new raid plus a revamped iconic Classic raid (unnamed).
impact: The 10/20 model is the long-term format, so build the roster around it.

title: Onyxia: same fight, fire resistance advised, loot expected to change
classic: Three-phase Onyxia with Deep Breath; fire resistance helped tanks.
forever: Blizzard describes the same three-phase heavy-fire encounter and advises fire resistance; Method expects rewards to change considerably and RankedBoost shows 16 drops still unrevealed.
impact: Prepare fire resistance and expect Onyxia's loot table to surprise you.

title: Resistance gear not needed for the opening raids
classic: Molten Core demanded fire resistance and later raids nature/frost/shadow sets.
forever: ConquestCapped says resistance gear is not needed for the opening raids (Onyxia fire resistance aside).
impact: Do not farm full resistance sets before December; keep some fire resistance for Onyxia.

title: Legendary tied to Hyjal Summit; later legendary questline
classic: Phase 1 had Thunderfury bindings from Molten Core.
forever: Blizzard teases a legendary reward from the new raids (Hyjal Summit); spring 2027 brings a legendary questline. Acquisition is unrevealed.
impact: Track any unusual drops and quest starters from Hyjal bosses.

title: Each raid clear awards Legacy Points
classic: No account progression existed.
forever: Legacy Challenges include defeating Onyxia, all 13 Hyjal Summit bosses and all 8 Barrow Deeps bosses (one point each).
impact: Full clears matter for account perks; skipping optional bosses costs a point.

title: Shouts, auras and key totems now reach the whole raid
classic: Battle Shout, Trueshot Aura, Moonkin Aura and Shaman totems only hit the caster's 5-player party.
forever: Dev notes (16 Oct): Battle Shout, Trueshot Aura, Moonkin Aura, and Grace of Air, Strength of Earth, Windfury and Flametongue totems are raid-wide; ConquestCapped adds Leader of the Pack and Furious Howl.
impact: Group composition and party-stacking around Shamans/Warriors stop mattering; one source of each buff covers everyone.

title: Only resistance auras are raid-wide; other paladin auras stay party-only
classic: All paladin auras affected the paladin's party.
forever: Fire, Frost and Shadow Resistance Auras reach all raid members within 30 yards; Devotion, Retribution and Concentration stay party-wide (Warcraft Tavern, ConquestCapped). Some secondary sites wrongly say all auras are raid-wide.
impact: Paladins still need party placement for Devotion/Concentration; one paladin covers raid resistance.

title: Blessing of Salvation removed entirely
classic: Salvation (-30% threat) went on every DPS and was a pillar of Classic threat management.
forever: Blizzard's 3 Nov dev notes: Salvation, Mass Salvation and Revoke removed; tank threat raised to compensate (Defensive Stance 80%, Bear 115%, Righteous Fury +33%).
impact: DPS must manage their own threat; use Fade/Feint/Cower and threat meters, and expect tanks to hold more.

title: Blessing of Light removed; Kings and Imp. Wisdom baseline
classic: Kings was a Protection talent, Improved Blessing of Wisdom a Holy talent, Blessing of Light a staple on tanks.
forever: Blessing of Kings and Improved Blessing of Wisdom are baseline; Blessing of Light (and Greater) removed; Sanctuary removed.
impact: Every paladin can bring Kings; blessing assignments simplify to Kings/Might/Wisdom.

title: Blessings last 1 hour; Blessing of Might nerfed ~39%
classic: Blessings lasted 5 minutes (Greater 15 minutes); Might rank 7 gave 185 AP (218 talented).
forever: Five-minute and Greater Blessings last 1 hour; Blessing of Might rank 7 gives 133 AP.
impact: Far less rebuffing on pulls, but Might is weaker for melee.

title: Battle Shout weaker but raid-wide with Improved Battle Shout built in
classic: Party-only Battle Shout; Improved Battle Shout was a talent.
forever: Battle Shout is raid-wide, its AP is reduced, and Improved Battle Shout is baked in.
impact: One warrior covers the raid; melee AP from shout is lower than you remember.

title: Windfury and Flametongue become totem buffs; totems last 5 minutes
classic: Windfury Totem placed a weapon enchant on party members' weapons; totems lasted 2 minutes.
forever: Windfury/Flametongue Totems are aura buffs (raid-wide per dev notes), persistent-buff totems last 5 minutes, totem GCD is 1 s, and totem presets via Call of the Elements. Since 10 Nov imbues and weapon totems work together.
impact: Shamans no longer need to sit in melee groups; Windfury affects the whole raid's melee.

title: Resistance totems raid-wide; Tranquil Air removed
classic: Resistance totems were party-only; Tranquil Air reduced threat.
forever: Fire/Frost/Nature Resistance Totems give their bonus to the entire raid; Tranquil Air Totem removed.
impact: Shaman threat reduction is gone along with Salvation.

title: Leader of the Pack and Moonkin Aura no longer stack
classic: LotP gave 3% melee/ranged crit to the party; Moonkin Aura 3% spell crit to the party.
forever: Moonkin Aura is raid-wide; sources disagree whether it is spell-only (16 Oct notes) or all crit types (3 Nov notes), and it is now exclusive with Leader of the Pack.
impact: Bringing both a feral and a moonkin no longer doubles the crit buff.

title: Trueshot Aura moved up the tree and rescaled
classic: Trueshot Aura was a 31-point Marksmanship capstone and party-only.
forever: Trueshot Aura is a 21-point talent, raid-wide, with ranged AP 20/35/50/75/100 by rank; ConquestCapped says it is ranged AP only.
impact: Melee no longer benefit from Trueshot.

title: Curse of Shadow removed; Curse of the Elements covers all magic
classic: Curse of Shadow and Curse of the Elements split shadow/arcane vs fire/frost.
forever: Curse of Shadows is deleted; Curse of the Elements applies to all magic damage (top rank -75 resistances, +10% magic damage per ConquestCapped).
impact: One warlock curse slot does the job of two.

title: Curse of Agony and Doom become Banes; Recklessness drops AP
classic: Curse of Agony/Doom competed with utility curses for the one-curse limit.
forever: Agony and Doom are Banes (one Bane per warlock per target, separate from curses); Curse of Recklessness no longer raises the target's attack power.
impact: Warlocks can keep a DoT and a utility curse up together.

title: Shadow Weaving, Improved Scorch, Winter's Chill and Imp. Shadow Bolt are personal
classic: These debuffs boosted every caster of that school on the target.
forever: Shadow Weaving, Improved Scorch, Winter's Chill and Improved Shadow Bolt now only benefit the caster who applied them; each mage has their own Ignite.
impact: Stacking one school no longer multiplies raid damage; no need for a 'scorch mage'.

title: Expose Armor now equals 5 Sunders and no longer blocks Sunder
classic: Improved Expose Armor overwrote and blocked Sunder Armor.
forever: Expose Armor matches 5 stacks of Sunder at the same level and no longer blocks Sunder; Sunder threat scales with AP.
impact: Armor debuff coordination between rogues and warriors is simpler.

title: Hunter pets no longer receive player buffs
classic: Pets took Kings, Fortitude and other buffs.
forever: Pets cannot receive player stat buffs; they scale from the hunter's gear instead.
impact: Stop buffing pets; buff assignments shrink.

title: Camp buffs mirror class buffs but do not stack
classic: No camping system.
forever: Profession camp objects give buffs that copy class buffs at slightly lower power (e.g. 8% stats vs Kings' 10%) and do not stack with them.
impact: Camps help pug or small groups, not a full raid already buffed.

title: Debuff limit for Forever unannounced
classic: Bosses had a debuff cap that forced debuff priority.
forever: ConquestCapped says no debuff limit has been given for Forever; the removed-limit change people cite applies to Anniversary realms.
impact: Assign debuff priority until the limit is known.

title: World buffs and Sayge fortunes do not work in raids or battlegrounds
classic: Onyxia/Rend heads, Songflower, Dire Maul tribute, ZG and DMF buffs were central to Classic raiding.
forever: Client text marks six of seven world buffs and all eight Sayge fortunes as having no effect in raid instances; Icy Veins/Massively OP report raids and battlegrounds. Spirit of Zandalar lacks the note (untested).
impact: No world-buff pre-farming or raid logging; consumables and raid buffs are the whole picture.

title: More world-buff drop points
classic: Rend buff dropped only in Orgrimmar/Crossroads or Stormwind.
forever: Rend's buff is now also delivered at Razor Hill/Crossroads (Horde) and Goldshire, Lakeshire, Sentinel Hill (Alliance).
impact: Useful for leveling and dungeons, not raids.

title: Melee, ranged and spell hit merged into one stat
classic: Separate melee hit and spell hit; casters stacked spell hit to 16%.
forever: A single Hit Chance stat covers melee, ranged, spells, poisons, traps and taunts; gear lists flat percentages.
impact: Hybrid gear is less wasted; recalc caps for every spec.

title: New hit caps: 8% melee, 17% spells vs bosses (approx.)
classic: Melee needed ~9% (8% with skill 305+) and spells 16% against a level 63 boss.
forever: ConquestCapped (15 Oct beta) gives 5%/8% melee and 4%/17% spells vs equal/boss; Warcraft Tavern's stats guide gives 9% melee and 16% spell miss vs bosses. The 1% spell-miss floor is unconfirmed.
impact: Treat 8%/17% as targets until your logs confirm; conflicting numbers in guides.

title: Dual-wield auto-attack penalty ~19%; special attacks 8%
classic: Dual-wield added a 19% miss penalty to white hits; Dual Wield Specialization added hit.
forever: Penalty is roughly 19% on white swings only; Dual Wield Specialization no longer adds hit and Heroic Strike queuing no longer boosts off-hand hit (Fury's Furious Precision replaces both).
impact: Rogues and Fury warriors should cap 8% for specials.

title: Weapon skill nerfed; Expertise replaces it
classic: +weapon skill gear and racials (Human swords/maces, Orc axes) cut glancing and misses.
forever: Weapon skill items were severely nerfed; Expertise replaces weapon skill in a Burning Crusade-like way; skill below max still costs ~0.04% hit/crit per point and drives glancing.
impact: Edgemaster's-style weapon-skill gear is no longer a priority; skill up new weapons before raiding.

title: Crit merged; bonus healing gives one-third as spell damage
classic: Separate melee/spell crit; +healing gear gave no damage.
forever: Crit chance is a single stat; bonus healing gear also grants one-third as much spell damage.
impact: Healers do slightly more damage; hybrid itemization changes BiS math.

title: Haste exists as a stat
classic: Classic had almost no haste on gear.
forever: Tier 2-piece bonuses give +1% attack and casting speed; Skyborne Wind Blessed gives 3% haste; Natural flasks offer haste. Warcraft Tavern says haste figures are not yet known.
impact: A new stat for melee/hunter valuation.

title: Spell crits get +50% bonus; Intellect gives spell power via talents
classic: Spell crits did 150% damage; Intellect gave mana and spell crit only.
forever: Warcraft Tavern says spell crits are 50% more effective; several talents now convert Intellect to spell damage or AP (Champion of the Light, Mental Dexterity, Careful Aim, Arcane Blast stacks).
impact: Intellect matters more for some hybrids.

title: Class damage raised across the board; high-level mobs got more health
classic: Classic numbers.
forever: 3 Nov dev notes: damage raised on classes across the game with higher-level creature health raised to match; no big tuning planned before raids.
impact: Classic sims and breakpoints are unreliable; log your own.

title: Weapon specialization racials removed
classic: Human sword/mace, Orc axe and Dwarf gun skill bonuses shaped raid racial picks.
forever: Weapon skill racials are gone (Blizzard reportedly confirmed they won't return); Human gets Ruthless (+1% crit after 3 Nov), Orc Savage (+1% crit), Dwarf Artisan's Precision (+1% hit and spell hit).
impact: Racial choice for melee is far less important.

title: Tauren lost their hit bonus
classic: Endurance gave 5% health; Tauren had no hit racial.
forever: Early beta gave Endurance 1% hit; 16 Oct notes changed it to 2% crit damage/healing, while ConquestCapped says it now gives only 5% health. Plainsrunning adds stacking mount speed.
impact: Check current tooltip; sources conflict.

title: New race Skyborne and six new race/class combos
classic: Eight races, fixed race/class options.
forever: Skyborne (Horde shamans, Alliance mages; both warriors, hunters, rogues, druids), plus six new combinations for existing races (e.g. Human hunters).
impact: Recruit pool gains new class/race options; racial picks for raid comps need fresh thinking.

title: Talent trees rebuilt with 11/16/21/31 milestones; dual spec at 40
classic: Classic trees had milestones at 11/21/31; respec costs climbed to 50g; no dual spec.
forever: Talents start at 10 with a new 16-point gold medal; dual spec for 50 gold at 40, swapping out of combat; respec fees decay toward 1 gold. Over 100 new talents across classes.
impact: Players can hold a raid and a farm/PvP spec; expect very different builds to Classic.

title: Abilities must be bought from trainers; ~206 gold to train 1-60
classic: Spells were also trained, cheaper overall.
forever: Training 1-60 costs about 206-207 gold for all classes; learning a spell no longer auto-adds it to bars.
impact: Fresh 60s may be short on gold for raid consumables.

title: Rage normalized; tank threat buffed
classic: Rage from damage scaled with damage taken/dealt; Defensive Stance +30% threat.
forever: Rage from dealing damage depends on weapon speed; rage from taking hits ignores armor and absorbs; crits give 75% more rage. Defensive Stance threat +80%, Defiance 7/13/20%.
impact: Warrior tanks start faster with gear-independent rage and hold more threat without Salvation on DPS.

title: Warrior cooldowns decoupled; Victory Rush, Tactical Mastery baseline
classic: Recklessness, Retaliation and Shield Wall shared a 30-minute cooldown.
forever: They no longer share a cooldown (Shield Wall/Retaliation 15 min); Tactical Mastery (keep 10 rage), Victory Rush, Improved Shield Block/Taunt baseline; Thunder Clap usable in Defensive Stance; new talents like Spearing Strike, Raging Blows, Bastion, Vanguard.
impact: More tank cooldowns per fight; plan rotations of Shield Wall.

title: Fury rebuilt: Bloodthirst needs Death Wish, Flurry changed
classic: Bloodthirst healed and was the 31-point talent; Flurry +30% after crits.
forever: Bloodthirst no longer heals and gives movement speed; it now requires Death Wish (3 Nov); Death Wish raises all damage taken; Flurry is 10/20/30% for 3 swings.
impact: Fury warriors take more damage; healers watch Death Wish.

title: Paladins can tank: Seal of Fury, Righteous Fury baseline, Holy Strike
classic: Protection paladins struggled with taunt and mana; Righteous Fury +60% Holy threat.
forever: Seal of Fury (level 10, absorb shield; its Judgement taunts at range), Holy Strike (level 6), Righteous Fury from level 10 (+33% all threat, +90% Holy), Consecration baseline but only 4 targets take full damage, Templar's Bulwark (100% health absorb).
impact: Paladins are viable main tanks; Consecration is weak on big packs.

title: Judgement no longer eats the seal; Seal twisting reworked
classic: Judging consumed the seal; seal-twisting was a niche trick; Judgements lasted 10 s.
forever: Judgement no longer consumes the seal; baseline seal twisting removed in favour of Retribution's Twist of Light; Judgement debuffs last 40 s; Judgement of the Crusader 15% stronger.
impact: Less judgement upkeep for raid debuffs like Wisdom/Light.

title: Holy Shock 10-second cooldown; Lay on Hands 20 minutes; Divine Shield halves damage
classic: Holy Shock 30 s; Lay on Hands 1 hour; bubble removed attack speed only.
forever: Holy Shock is a 21-point talent with a 10 s cooldown; Lay on Hands 20 min; Divine Shield now halves your damage dealt; Light's Vigil now friendly only.
impact: More paladin emergency healing per raid night.

title: Fear Ward, Devouring Plague, Divine Spirit, SW:Death for every priest
classic: Fear Ward was Dwarf-only, Devouring Plague Undead-only, Divine Spirit a talent.
forever: Fear Ward and Devouring Plague at level 20, Divine Spirit at 30, Shadow Word: Death at 32 for all priests.
impact: Any priest can Fear Ward a tank; race no longer gates raid utility.

title: Priest healing toolkit expanded; Prayer of Healing targets any party
classic: Prayer of Healing only healed the priest's own party; one Renew per target.
forever: Prayer of Healing heals the target's party; Renew from multiple priests stacks; Penance, Prayer of Mending, Divine Aegis added; Binding Heal removed (Holy Binding instead); Lightwell removed.
impact: Priest group assignments become flexible.

title: Shadowform no longer blocks non-healing spells; weaving personal
classic: Shadowform blocked Holy spells; Shadow Weaving buffed all shadow damage.
forever: Shadowform allows non-healing spells, halves shadow mana cost, doubles shadow crit bonus; Vampiric Embrace 30 s cooldown; Shadow Weaving self-only.
impact: Shadow priests become solo DPS rather than warlock support.

title: Feral druids can use potions and get real threat
classic: Shapeshifting broke on potions; bears had +50% threat and weapon procs didn't work.
forever: Most consumables usable without leaving form; weapon enchants/procs work in form; auto attack uses weapon DPS; Bear threat +115%; Lacerate at 42; Primal Bite; Berserk removed (3 Nov).
impact: Bears and cats become solid raid tanks/DPS; plan feral consumables.

title: Restoration gains Wild Growth; Swiftmend keeps HoTs
classic: Swiftmend consumed Rejuvenation/Regrowth.
forever: Wild Growth (31-point), Swiftmend no longer consumes the HoT, Gift of the Earthmother replaced by Bloom, Nature's Swiftness also works on Wild Growth.
impact: Druids become strong raid healers.

title: Balance reworked: Eclipse, Insect Swarm hit debuff, Faerie Fire in form
classic: Moonkin was a meme spec; Faerie Fire needed caster form.
forever: Eclipse (Wrath speeds Starfire), Insect Swarm reduces target hit by 2% (doesn't stack), Faerie Fire castable in bear/cat with no cost, Hurricane no cooldown.
impact: Moonkins bring a real tank debuff and AoE.

title: Aimed Shot baseline; Lone Wolf, Sniper Shot; Auto Shot needs standing still
classic: Aimed Shot was a Marksmanship talent.
forever: Aimed Shot is baseline at 20 (shares cooldown with Multi-Shot); Lone Wolf +20% without a pet; Sniper Shot; Auto Shot requires 0.5 s standing still; traps usable in combat (shared 30 s cooldown).
impact: Hunters can raid without pets; movement costs more DPS.

title: Mage: Frostfire Bolt, Arcane Blast, Ice Lance; Cold Snap 10 min
classic: Frostbolt spam; Cold Snap 5-minute cooldown.
forever: Frostfire Bolt (level 40), Arcane Blast (stacking), Ice Lance and Fingers of Frost, Heating Up for Pyroblast, Cold Snap 10 min, Precision 6% hit to all spells; Frost Blast removed.
impact: Mage rotation and gear values change; no more Fire/Frost mono-spec raids by default.

title: Shaman: Lava Burst removed, Riptide/Water Shield, Stormstrike retuned
classic: Elemental Mastery and Stormstrike (20 s) defined the specs.
forever: Lava Burst removed and replaced by Call of Thunder (3 Nov); Riptide (12 s), Water Shield, Maelstrom Weapon, Rage of the Farseer; Stormstrike 100% weapon damage, 8 s cooldown after 10 Nov hotfix; Enhancement moved to Strength.
impact: Elemental tier 5-piece (Lava Burst) is now dead text; Enhancement wants Strength gear.

title: Rogue: Mutilate, Shank, Hack and Slash, poisons with stones
classic: Weapon specs per type; poisons replaced sharpening stones.
forever: Mutilate (21-point), Shank (24), Death Mark, Venom; Hack and Slash replaces weapon specs; poisons stack with stones; Feint threat drop doubled; one-hand axes usable; several Subtlety talents removed 3 Nov.
impact: Rogues can use both poisons and stones; more threat headroom.

title: Warlock: Life Tap scales with Spirit, Wrack, Incinerate; pets scale
classic: Life Tap scaled with spell damage; seventeen-plus talents later removed.
forever: Life Tap scales with Spirit; Firestone/Spellstone are weapon imbues stacking with Wizard Oil (Spellstone shadow only); Wrack (6 s channel since 10 Nov), Incinerate, Bane of Havoc; Drain Soul shards; pets scale from master's stats.
impact: Warlocks need Spirit and wizard oil; shard farming is easier.

title: Pets and Voidwalkers made sturdier (10 Nov)
classic: Pets tanked well in Classic.
forever: Blizzard's 10 Nov tuning aims to make hunter pets and Voidwalkers about as durable as in Classic Era; hunter pets fixed to 115% health.
impact: Minor for raids; useful for pet tanking on trash.

title: Item stats hidden until someone on your realm loots it
classic: All items were known and in AtlasLoot/Wowhead from day one.
forever: Blizzard (Greenfield) says stats stay hidden until the item drops for someone on your server; about 40% of items (12,500+) shipped without stats, raid loot included; first raid weeks are a 'Wild West' with no BiS.
impact: Loot councils cannot plan BiS in advance; record drops and share findings.

title: Tier 1 is new class/role sets at item level 65
classic: Tier 1 (Molten Core) had one set per class, 8 pieces, item level 66.
forever: Each class gets new sets per role (18 total: e.g. Battlegear vs Battleplate of Glory), 6 pieces, item level 65, BoP; bonuses at 2/3/4/5 pieces (5 is the cap); stats hidden.
impact: Hybrids need separate set pieces per role; plan loot by spec, not class.

title: Tier set bonus template: role stat, utility, creature-type damage, signature cooldown
classic: Classic set bonuses were mixed stats, procs and the 8-piece capstone.
forever: 2-piece: role stat (1% hit for casters, 1% haste for melee/hunters, 10 Spirit healers, 7 Defense tanks); 3-piece utility; 4-piece bonus vs one creature type (e.g. +36 AP vs Humanoids) or +26 healing; 5-piece signature ability.
impact: The 4-piece is situational by boss type; 2-piece hit counts toward caps.

title: Some tier bonuses reference removed abilities
classic: Not applicable.
forever: Shaman Elemental 5-piece reduces Lava Burst cooldown, Druid Guardian 5-piece Berserk; both removed on 3 Nov. Paladin Retribution 4-piece listed as vs Undead (ConquestCapped) or Demons (wow.gg); Feral 5-piece listed as Tiger's Fury or Shifting Power.
impact: Expect tier bonuses to change before or at raid opening; don't promise pieces on a bonus.

title: Crafted tier pieces (item level 61) with an equip limit
classic: Tier sets were raid-only.
forever: Tailoring, Leatherworking and Blacksmithing at 300 make shoulders, hands, legs and feet of each set at item level 61 (BoE), using Malleable Essence of Nature from disenchanting new-raid loot; Unique-Equipped: Artisan's Tier (1), raised to 2 by Rousing Seed Pod (Revered Guardians of Hyjal).
impact: Enchanters disenchanting raid loot feed the guild's tier; route spare drops to DE.

title: Head and chest tier only from raids
classic: All T1 pieces came from MC bosses.
forever: No crafted head or chest exists; a 5-piece needs 4 raid pieces plus 1 crafted (or 3+2 with Seed Pod). Boss-to-slot drops are unpublished.
impact: Prioritize head/chest drops in loot rules.

title: Guardians of Hyjal reputation gates crafted tier
classic: No reputation tied to tier.
forever: Friendly plus 'Friendly Advice' unlocks leg plans; further rep and slot specialization unlock others; Revered grants Rousing Seed Pod (10 g). Vendors Aisarra Nightmeadow and Rhylin Stonethorn in Mount Hyjal; 72 tier recipes sold.
impact: Start Guardians of Hyjal rep on crafters and raiders now.

title: Rare 'chase' item on every raid boss
classic: Rare drops existed but no designed chase table.
forever: Every boss can drop a low-chance chase item with strong effects; hidden class-changing items hinted (e.g. a sword for a battle-mage).
impact: Agree loot rules for chase items before they drop.

title: Dungeon sets (D1/D2) rebuilt with 2-6 piece thresholds
classic: Dungeon Set 1 had 2/4/6/8-piece bonuses including +200 armor.
forever: Datamined: 8-piece bonuses removed; 2-piece now +8 all resistances; bonuses at 2/3/4/5/6 with active effects (e.g. Valor's Moment of Valor); D2 Valthalak questline returns.
impact: Pre-raid D1/D2 set value differs from Classic lists.

title: Classic sets reworked (Postmaster, Cadaverous, Imperial Plate etc.)
classic: Postmaster gave run speed and armor; Cadaverous gave resistances.
forever: Datamined: Postmaster gets spell damage, a reflect and 1% hit; Cadaverous/Necropile/Bloodmail/Deathbone lower resistance bonuses but gain hit/AP/crit; Imperial Plate swaps armor for Defense and hit.
impact: Old pre-raid sets have new value; check before vendoring.

title: Hit on gear is flat percent and scarce below 50
classic: Hit came as 1%/2% on specific items.
forever: Gear hit is a percentage (e.g. Stromgarde Hood 0.5%, Lionheart Helm 2%) and mostly appears around level 50.
impact: Hit caps come mainly from talents and tier 2-piece.

title: Dungeon loot reworked; BoP dungeon appearances shared
classic: Classic 60 dungeons kept their original loot.
forever: Level 60 Classic dungeons return with reworked loot and quests; BoP green/blue dungeon drops grant their appearance to all eligible group members; some quest rewards downgraded rare to uncommon.
impact: Old pre-raid BiS lists are wrong; rely on discovery.

title: Bad epic world drops removed; niche species/biome trinkets
classic: World epics included many weak items.
forever: Method: epic world drops revamped to remove bad epics; new species- and biome-specific trinkets; rares more rewarding.
impact: World drops may be real upgrades; post them.

title: No catch-up system; gear power steps are small
classic: Each phase added much stronger gear.
forever: ConquestCapped: no dedicated catch-up; vertical power rises in smaller steps between raid tiers; soft reset undecided.
impact: Late joiners gear in the same raids; old raids remain relevant.

title: PvP gear: rare by Marks+Honor, epic via Emboldened Seal by rank
classic: Rank-gated epic sets; Rank 14 weapons; dishonorable grind with decay.
forever: Rare pieces bought with Honor and battleground Marks at 55+; Emboldened Seals (ranks 8-13) upgrade a rare piece to epic; epic weapons at Rank 14. Honor costs rose ~50% in October beta.
impact: PvP gear is a pre-raid route with a weekly cap.

title: Raid loot system not announced
classic: Master loot/group loot with loot council or DKP.
forever: No source found states the Forever raid loot method (personal, master or group); GuildOrder says check in-client.
impact: Have a plan for master loot and a fallback if it's personal.

title: Hundreds of new recipes; camp stations required for top crafts
classic: Recipes were mostly static; no camp crafting.
forever: 600+ new recipes (938 per ConquestCapped's count); dungeon-boss Blueprints teach top camp stations (Master Forge, Loom) required for tier crafts.
impact: Crafters need blueprints from dungeon runs before raids open.

title: Healing potions moved to First Aid; necklace enchants; flasks and elixirs stack
classic: Alchemy made healing potions; flasks and elixirs were exclusive.
forever: Basic healing potions are First Aid; necklaces can be enchanted; Method's beta list says flasks now stack with elixirs (unconfirmed), flasks persist through death.
impact: Consumable plans for raids differ; check stacking in game.

title: Natural flasks only work in Hyjal zones and raids
classic: Flasks worked anywhere.
forever: Four Natural flasks (+60 Stamina and 4-5% hit, crit, haste or dodge/parry) only function in Mount Hyjal, Hyjal Summit and Barrow Deeps.
impact: Alchemists should stock these for the new raids.

title: Specializations and profession window
classic: Some specializations existed (BS/LW/Eng).
forever: Blacksmithing, Engineering and Leatherworking specializations unlock exclusive recipes via quests; professions have their own searchable window; reagent bag slot.
impact: Coordinate guild crafter specializations.

title: Black Market NPCs sell scarce mats at fixed prices
classic: Black Lotus and rare mats were player-farmed only.
forever: Black Market NPCs sell certain materials (e.g. Black Lotus per ConquestCapped) at a set price, capping prices.
impact: Flask costs have a ceiling.

title: No XP-to-gold at 60; quests 48+ give gold
classic: Max-level quests converted XP to gold.
forever: XP-to-gold at level 60 disabled; most quests 48+ now give gold (10 Nov hotfix).
impact: Saved quest logs are not a gold source; fund consumables differently.

title: Modern Auction House; 1 copper minimum deposit from 17 Nov
classic: Classic AH UI with deposits.
forever: A newer Auction House interface. Fan sites describe the modern one: separate buy and sell tabs, with materials sold as commodities, cheapest first. The minimum deposit drops from 1 silver to 1 copper with the 17 Nov maintenance, and stays 1 silver until then.
impact: Easier selling of mats for raid funds.

title: New supply factions and Merchant's Favor
classic: No supply reputation in Classic.
forever: Azeroth Commerce Authority and Durotar Supply and Logistics sell crafting recipes for Merchant's Favor.
impact: Crafters gain recipes via crates.

title: Riding costs more; mount included in training
classic: Riding training and the mount were bought separately and cost less at level 40.
forever: Apprentice Riding 100 g including a basic mount; Journeyman 1,000 g plus 200 g swift mount; Honored rep -10%; mounts account-wide.
impact: Fresh 60s need about 1,200 g for epic mounts.

title: Rank is personal, weekly-capped and does not decay
classic: Rank depended on server standing with weekly decay.
forever: Rank Points fill a personal bar (24,750 for Rank 14, earliest week 10), reset per season; Honor capped at 25,000.
impact: PvP gear is achievable alongside raiding.

title: New 15v15 Darkspear Islands battleground
classic: WSG, AB, AV.
forever: Darkspear Islands, 15v15, level 30+, four capture points plus a flag.
impact: Marks from it are needed for some PvP gear.

title: Faction balance creation limits
classic: No limits.
forever: Blizzard tightened character creation for the more populous faction on PvP rulesets (Horde NA PvP, Alliance EU RP-PvP).
impact: Recruiting alts may be blocked on the larger faction.

title: Add-ons restricted like retail Midnight
classic: Classic add-on API allowed DBM, WeakAuras-style logic.
forever: Kami-Labs reports (citing a 14 Sep interview) that Forever add-ons face the same combat restrictions as retail Midnight; Blizzard added a Cooldown Manager, Damage Meter, Edit Mode, nameplate options and mouseover casting.
impact: Plan around built-in tools; some raid add-ons may not work.

title: Account-wide collections, transmog, reagent bag
classic: None of these existed.
forever: Account-wide mounts, pets, toys and appearances; transmog; dedicated reagent bag slot; bags no longer auto-equip.
impact: Quality-of-life; minor for raid planning.

title: No flying, new boat routes
classic: No flying; a smaller set of boat and zeppelin routes.
forever: No flying mounts; new routes like Stormwind-Auberdine, Southshore-Auberdine, Gadgetzan-Powderfuse Port; mages can teleport others.
impact: Travel times for raids unchanged.

title: Dungeon XP +50%, rested bag, food XP
classic: Standard XP.
forever: Dungeon kill XP +50% (8 Nov); Cozy Sleeping Bag grants rested XP; food gives 5% kill XP.
impact: Recruits reach 60 faster.

title: New zones and dungeons 1-60
classic: Original zones.
forever: Zephras Isle, Riverglades, Shen'dralas, Mount Hyjal; nine new dungeons incl. Blackmaw Hold and Shaper's Terrace at 55-60.
impact: Pre-raid gearing includes new 60 dungeons.

title: Roadmap: Hardcore winter, spring and summer 2027 updates
classic: Phased Classic release.
forever: Hardcore in winter 2026-27; spring 2027: 2 raids, 2 dungeons, legendary questline; summer: revamped iconic raid, new raid, 2 dungeons.
impact: Next raid tier around spring 2027.

title: Classic raids return later
classic: MC, BWL, AQ phased in.
forever: Warcraft Tavern says other vanilla raids return in future; RankedBoost lists MC, BWL, AQ pages without dates; Scarlet Enclave planned.
impact: Old raids will come with reworked loot.
